basic_info.description: 1215 Vallejo is a truly classic flat with soaring ceiling height in fantastic Russian Hill. Light streams in from every angle in this newly done, lovely 3 br 2 ba home. The south facing view greatroom is a sun-filled joy. The luxurious primary suite is large and features a walk-in closet and luxe primary bath. Indeed each of the the bedrooms are at luxurious scale, with ample closet space. And there is a laundry room for ease of living. This home is a true rarity, a true 3/2 on one of the best locations in Russian Hill. The location is tranquil but still just close enough to the amenities of Hyde st and Polk st. Nearby parking has been secured. This is an amazing offering in a top San Franicsco neighborhood.
